apiVersion: v1
kind: Pod
metadata: {name: harbor-probes}
spec:
  terminationGracePeriodSeconds: 20
  containers:
    - name: app
      image: harbor-service:lab
      imagePullPolicy: Never
      ports: [{name: http, containerPort: 8080}]
      startupProbe:
        httpGet: {path: /startup, port: http}
        periodSeconds: 2
        failureThreshold: 30
      livenessProbe:
        httpGet: {path: /live, port: http}
        periodSeconds: 5
        timeoutSeconds: 1
      readinessProbe:
        httpGet: {path: /ready, port: http}
        periodSeconds: 2
        timeoutSeconds: 1
